title: Selection Shapes the Boundary: A Replication of Monotonicity and Label Agreement in Unselected NLI Populations
abstract: arXiv:2607.19231v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prior work on human label variation (HLV) in natural language inference (NLI) has often relied on re-annotation resources that select items by disagreement level. An earlier study (Choi, 2026, arXiv:2607.15870) found that hypotheses containing non-upward monotonicity operators showed somewhat higher label entropy in ChaosNLI (Cliff's delta = -0.284), a difference that study reports as sensitive to tagger error. In its SNLI and MultiNLI portions, ChaosNLI re-annotates only items whose majority label carries exactly three of five votes. We replicate this boundary in the unselected populations that ChaosNLI was drawn from. We use the SNLI and MultiNLI development sets with the same operator tagger and a four-level ordinal agreement outcome, under a plan frozen in our working repository before analysis. translated_title: 选择塑造边界：在未筛选的自然语言推理人群中复制单调性与标签一致性研究
translated_abstract: 以往关于自然语言推理（NLI）中人类标签变异（HLV）的研究常常依赖于按不一致程度筛选条目的重新标注资源。较早的一项研究（Choi, 2026, arXiv:2607.15870）发现，在ChaosNLI中，包含非向上单调性算子的假设显示出略高的标签熵（Cliff's delta = -0.284），该研究报告称这一差异对标注器错误敏感。在其SNLI和MultiNLI部分，ChaosNLI仅对多数标签恰好获得五票中三票的条目进行重新标注。我们在ChaosNLI所来源的未筛选人群中复制这一边界效应。我们使用SNLI和MultiNLI开发集，采用相同的算子标注器和四级序数一致性结果，且分析方案在分析开始前已在我们工作仓库中冻结。计划中的预测失败了。所有七个对比均返回正的Cliff's delta（非向上条目的一致性略高而非略低）……
tldr: 本研究在未筛选的SNLI/MultiNLI人群中预注册复制了先前基于筛选数据的发现，结果与原预测相反——含非向上单调性算子的假设标签一致性略高而非略低，表明ChaosNLI按分歧程度筛选条目的机制可能塑造了先前观察到的单调性与标签一致性之间的边界效应。
en_tdlr: A preregistered replication in unselected SNLI/MultiNLI populations finds that hypotheses containing non-upward monotonicity operators show slightly higher—not lower—label agreement, contradicting prior findings from selected ChaosNLI data and suggesting that disagreement-based item selection shapes the observed boundary.
